scope: Tight domain-matched support mask for EPIC Ego robot/bottle repair
summary: A 32-level threshold with 7-pixel close and 13-pixel dilation reduced mean action support to about 25% while retaining the generated robot arms and blue bottle, materially reducing the fog artifact.
evidence: Window-00 pour mean support fell from 0.5788 to 0.2497.
Reviewed tight-support frames preserve both forearms, hands, and bottle while restoring substantially more of the exact public-Ego background.
The support-mask unit tests and full repository test suite pass.
lessons: A domain-calibrated threshold and bounded morphology are required before repair-recipe training has meaningful inputs.
